summary.text: Colin Mitchell is a Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Carroll 8, in the November 3, 2026 general election; he defeated incumbent Brian R. Taylor in the September 8 Republican primary.
A data analyst and Army National Guard veteran, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that his priorities are opposing tax increases, protecting gun rights and reforming family court.

paragraphs.text: Mitchell served in the U.S. Army National Guard from 2011 to 2025 and earned undergraduate and graduate degrees in applied mathematics from Northeastern University.

His career experience includes working as a data analyst, business intelligence engineer and coder, and in a Ballotpedia survey he said he rose to Staff Sergeant during fifteen years of service and took part in disaster relief efforts.
Mitchell said in the survey that he would vote against tax increases and work to reduce existing taxes while keeping New Hampshire free of an income or sales tax.

He also said he would introduce legislation to require a hearing with both parties present before firearms are seized under New Hampshire's restraining order system, and to establish a presumption of shared parenting in family courts.
